legislation: BCI Rules on Standards of Professional Conduct and Etiquette
barCouncilRules.hitlRequirement: MANDATORY for all court filings, formal opinions, client-facing advice

Solicitation or marketing content for legal services (Rule 36)
Court submissions without advocate signature line

barCouncilRules.governingBody: Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) + Bar Standards Board (BSB)
barCouncilRules.hitlRequirement: MANDATORY — SRA AI Guidance 2024 requires supervising solicitor review of all AI outputs before client delivery
barCouncilRules.mandatoryDisclaimer: This document was prepared with AI assistance and has been reviewed by a solicitor/barrister regulated by the Solicitors Regulation Authority / Bar Standards Board. AI use is disclosed in compliance with SRA AI Guidance 2024.
prohibitedOutputs: AI outputs delivered directly to clients without SRA AI Guidance 2024 compliant solicitor review
Court documents without supervising solicitor sign-off (SRA Code 6.3)
AI-generated case citations without ICLR Official Law Reports verification
Processing client personal data through AI without UK GDPR lawful basis

barCouncilRules.governingBody: American Bar Association (ABA) + State Bar Associations
legislation: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct 2023
barCouncilRules.hitlRequirement: MANDATORY — ABA Opinion 512 requires attorney supervision and verification of all AI-generated work product before delivery to client or court
citationStandard: Full reporter citation — Mata v Avianca compliance mandatory
barCouncilRules.mandatoryDisclaimer: This document was prepared with AI assistance under the supervision of a licensed attorney in compliance with ABA Formal Opinion 512 (2024). AI use has been or will be disclosed to the client as required.
prohibitedOutputs: Unverified case citations in court documents — absolute prohibition after Mata v Avianca (Rule 3.3)
AI-generated work product delivered without attorney review and Opinion 512 compliance
Billing AI time at attorney hourly rates without client disclosure
Client data input to external LLMs without Rule 1.6 compliant consent

Deployment in EU court proceedings without EU AI Act conformity assessment
Cross-border advice without compliance with both home bar and host bar rules

gate8_bar_council.description: Bar Council compliance gate — runs after 7 existing JESS gates, before output delivery

enforcementLevels.WARN: Log violation, allow output with warning flag
enforcementLevels.BLOCK: Return 403 with violation reason, output not delivered
enforcementLevels.HITL: Route to compliance review queue, release on approval
enforcementLevels.MANDATORY_HITL: Always route to human review regardless of confidence score — EU statutory requirement

gate8_bar_council.euSpecialRule: JCN-EU: MANDATORY_HITL always enforced regardless of any platform configuration — GDPR Art 22 + EU AI Act Art 14 are statutes
